title: odata - Is it valid to return a body along with an Http 204 ...
snippet: Feb 23, 2012 · The 204 response to PUT is not a mandatory requirement for OData servers (note that the odata.org is not a normative reference, the MS-OData document is). You can return 200 with body, in which case the body you return should be a serialization of the updated entity (after the updates were applied by the server).
